name: WordWorld eleventh fresh 50-command evaluation — 2026-10-16
method: 50 newly hand-authored commands and expected actions frozen before first prediction, after adding language edits (recolor/resize/move), cross-request references and thirds/fifths/percentages. The author wrote the grammar and saw prior errors; not independent.
scope: 40 preassigned core cases (edits, landmarks, directions, chains, references with client context, fractions, negation, unmapped colors, missing values, agreement and non-integral fractions) and 10 broader probes.

metric_definitions.exact_match: Complete ordered action dictionaries match, including all emitted fields; per command over all 50.
metric_definitions.intent: Ordered action-name sequence matches; per command over all 50. Does not validate entity or setting value.
metric_definitions.entity_count_color: Ordered (action, type, count, color) tuples for all typed actions match, per command over all 50. Pure setting/no-op cases contribute empty typed-action lists.
metric_definitions.spatial: Ordered (type, relation, target, targets) tuples for all typed actions match, on gold-spatial commands only. Extra subjects are penalized.
metric_definitions.settings: Ordered (key, value) tuples for setting actions match, on gold-setting commands only.

cases.text: Paint the cottage pink.
Colour all the flowers orange.
Make the woods purple.
Dye the yellow flowers blue.
Change the colour of the homes to green.
Change the house to orange.
Paint the castle red.
cases.label_note: Castles have no color mapping; a notice, no action.
warnings: Castles have no color to change; houses, trees and flowers can be repainted.

cases.text: Don't paint the trees white.
warnings: Skipped a negated instruction; no objects were changed for that clause.

cases.text: Make the lake bigger.
Make all the rocks much smaller.
Enlarge the tower slightly.
Shrink the mountains.
Make the bridge a little larger.
Resize the castle.
warnings: Could not tell how to resize those objects; name a color, bigger/smaller, a direction or a place such as 'behind the lake'.

cases.text: Move the castle next to the river.
Move the flowers in front of the cottage.
Relocate the tower to the right of the mountain.
Shift the rock between the lake and the road.
Move two of the trees behind the castle.
Move the bridge across the river.
Move the house to the left.
Slide the castle a bit to the right.
Shift the trees far back.
Move the lake forward.
Paint the houses red and the flowers white.
Make the castle bigger and move it behind the lake.
Build two towers, then make them smaller.
Plant a tree and paint it orange.
Make it purple.
Move them to the left of the lake.
Make them much bigger.
Get rid of it.
Put two flowers next to it.
Paint it white.
warnings: 'it' needs one unambiguous object, not a plural group.

cases.text: Plant a tree and make it pink.
Plant fifteen trees: a third pink and the rest green.
Create ten flowers: 40% white and 60% yellow.
Build six houses: two thirds blue and one third red.
Plant five trees: one fifth orange and four fifths green.
Build seven houses: a third blue and the rest red.
warnings: Fraction groups need a declared total giving non-negative whole-object counts and a partition; that instruction was skipped.

cases.text: Turn the two blue houses white.
warnings: Skipped a context-only or unsupported instruction; use an explicit add/build/plant verb to create objects.

cases.text: Give the cottage a red roof.
warnings: Skipped a context-only or unsupported instruction; use an explicit add/build/plant verb to create objects.

cases.text: Move the castle closer to the lake.
warnings: Could not tell how to move those objects; name a color, bigger/smaller, a direction or a place such as 'behind the lake'.

cases.text: Make both houses green.
Make the houses a bit taller.
Move the castle up a little.
warnings: Ignored words after the edit: 'a little'.

cases.text: Make it night and paint the houses blue.
Recolor every cottage in purple.
Plant twelve flowers: 25 per cent pink, a quarter white and the rest yellow.
Make them yellow and move them next to the road.
